text: Photography is an artistic practice that uses a camera to record images of the world. At its core, the art of photography involves capturing light to create visual stories. The shutter, a mechanical or electronic device, controls how long the camera sensor is exposed to light, effectively determining the exposure of the image. The shutter speed can be adjusted to capture motion, freeze action, or blur motion, offering photographers the ability to tell their unique stories through light and timing. While the shutter works in harmony with the aperture, a variable opening in the lens, to control the amount of light that hits the sensor, both elements are critical in composing and capturing images. Ultimately, photography is a language of light, revealing the beauty and complexity of the world through the lens.
